label: CLINICAL_REPORT
text: Seen today for review of knee pain. Mr Example reports the pain has gone on for about a year, worse on stairs. He did eight weeks of physio last winter and says it helped only slightly. Examination: swollen, a bit warm, grating on movement. Plan: discuss options, trial of topical gel, see again in a month.

label: CLINICAL_REPORT
text: Discharge note. Admitted overnight with chest tightness; troponin repeat was reassuring and symptoms settled. Sent home on current meds, GP to follow up within one week. Advised to return if pain recurs.

label: CLINICAL_REPORT
text: S: back pain radiating down left leg x 3 weeks. O: SLR positive at 40 degrees, reflexes normal. A: probable lumbar radiculopathy. P: NSAIDs, gentle exercise, reassess 4-6 wks, red flags explained.

label: CLINICAL_REPORT
text: Follow-up visit. Blood pressure well controlled on amlodipine. No side effects. Discussed diet and salt intake. Next appointment in six months.

label: IMAGING_REPORT
text: MRI right knee. Findings: tear of the medial meniscus posterior horn, cartilage thinning in the medial compartment, small effusion. Cruciate and collateral ligaments intact. Conclusion: degenerative medial meniscal tear with early osteoarthritis.

label: IMAGING_REPORT
text: Chest radiograph PA view. Lungs are clear. Heart size is normal. No pleural effusion or pneumothorax. Bony thorax unremarkable. Radiologist: fictional reader.

label: IMAGING_REPORT
text: CT abdomen and pelvis with contrast for abdominal pain. The liver, spleen and pancreas look normal. No bowel obstruction. Appendix not inflamed. No free fluid.

label: IMAGING_REPORT
text: Ultrasound of the right shoulder: the supraspinatus tendon is thickened with a partial thickness tear. Subacromial bursa fluid present. Biceps tendon in groove.

label: LABORATORY_RESULT
text: Blood tests collected 12/03/2025. HbA1c 58 mmol/mol (high). Fasting glucose 8.1. Cholesterol 5.9. Kidney function normal, eGFR 88. Lab comment: results consistent with suboptimal glycaemic control.

label: LABORATORY_RESULT
text: FBC: Hb 11.2 L, WCC 7.4, Plt 250. Ferritin 9 L. B12 normal. Specimen received in good condition. Authorised by duty biochemist.

label: LABORATORY_RESULT
text: Urine culture: more than 100,000 cfu/mL E. coli. Sensitive to nitrofurantoin and trimethoprim. Resistant to ampicillin. Report issued after 48 h incubation.

label: LABORATORY_RESULT
text: Thyroid profile  TSH 5.8 mIU/L (0.4-4.0)  Free T4 12 pmol/L (9-19). Interpretation: borderline raised TSH, repeat in 6 weeks advised.

label: POLICY_DOCUMENT
text: Coverage determination guideline: knee replacement. Members qualify when there is radiographic evidence of advanced osteoarthritis, failure of at least three months of non-operative care, and functional impairment documented by the surgeon.

label: POLICY_DOCUMENT

text: Utilisation management criteria - spinal injections. Authorisation may be granted if conservative therapy has been tried for six weeks, pain is radicular, and imaging supports the level. Repeat injections require documented benefit.
